note: schematics only; no model is evaluated

panels.a: double-pass doped-fiber amplifier: circulator, WDM coupler, pump (980 or 1480 nm), Er-doped fiber, FRM
panels.b: transmission fiber with counter-propagating Raman pumps (several wavelengths) via WDM coupler, EDFA, GFF
panels.c: i) Raman pumps + one wideband SOA module, no band splitter; ii) band splitter in front of two band SOAs, pumps behind the splitter routed around it (bypass) to a coupler on the span side; iii) separate Raman pump module (coupler + pumps) in front of the band splitter
panels.d: band splitter, O: PDFA or BDFA, E: BDFA, S: TDFA, BDFA or Raman, C: EDFA, L: EDFA, U: discrete Raman, band combiner
panels.e: circulator, splitter/combiner, branch 1 EDF + Raman fiber, branch 2 Raman fiber, mirror, Raman pumps 1410/1480/1495 nm with residual-pump recycling (drawn after [80, 81]; pump routing simplified)
panels.f: OLT, feeder fiber, reach extender with two diplexers, downstream (S- or L-band) and upstream (O-band, burst mode) amplifiers, passive 1:N splitter, ONUs
